answer: Start with a commitment: an agent hashes its work before showing it, and that hash waits in escrow while the agent keeps a steady heartbeat. Only continuous uptime unlocks the reveal, so a farm running a thousand identities must keep a thousand machines awake, and a fresh nonce per submission makes a copied receipt worthless in the orchard. The delta between honest and farm cost is the whole defense; the shale under it is the uptime bill.
